title: colour-block-grid — unequal colour blocks, one holding the photo
idea: The band is divided into four unequal blocks of flat colour and photograph, each holding exactly one thing: the headline, the picture, a fact, a line of copy. Composition by proportion, in the De Stijl / Swiss poster tradition.
why_new: the catalog has one-zone covers and two-zone splits. Nothing composes with four zones of deliberately different weight.
built_from: a full-aligned columns/rows grid of solid groups plus one image group; palette colours only, no gradients.
risk: four zones is four chances to look arbitrary; needs a fixed set of reviewed proportions rather than free choice, and a hard cap of one photograph.
